Instead of wiring Actions, Dockerfiles, charts and TLS by hand, you plug in a repo and go from “GitHub repo” to “live HTTPS URL” without hiring a DevOps engineer.

records.name: Thawe - Professional Networking App
records.tagline: Lets rehumanize networking!
records.description: Thawe is a free mobile app launching January 20th that makes professional networking feel human. Endless feeds, influencers, spammy messages, and AI-generated content have made networking unnecessarily hard. Create a profile in under 90 seconds, then discover relevant people nearby or aligned with your interests. No feeds, no noise, just real people and real conversations. Thawe isn’t meant to replace in-person networking, but to support it, by helping you find the right people to meet.

records.name: ScanPi
records.tagline: AI chatbot in minutes. QR code, no signup.
records.description: ScanPi turns PDFs, docs, or webpages into accurate AI chatbots in minutes—no coding, no hallucinations.What sets it apart: • Zero friction: QR code → instant chat on WeChat (no app, no signup) • Enterprise security: Full data isolation across projects • Real-world use: Hotels (rules/Wi-Fi), HR onboarding, manuals—end repetitive questionsUnlike generic doc-chat tools, ScanPi focuses on effortless sharing and true privacy for businesses tired of ignored PDFs.Limited beta — join the waitlist!

records.name: Palex
records.tagline: A social network built around real books
records.description: Palex is a social network built around real, physical books. Easily add the books you own, discover new reads through people, and connect with readers who share your taste. It’s about libraries, lending, and human connection. Free on the App Store.

records.name: Caffeine Curfew iOS App
records.tagline: Track caffeine intake, hydration, and master your sleep
records.description: Caffeine Curfew is a native iOS and WatchOS App that allows user to track the active half life decay of their caffeine intake. We support Apple Heath Integration, Homescreen Widgets, and we offer sleep analysis tools to help users get a better understanding of their productivity and rest. We take pride in listening to our users and iterating quickly.

records.name: WAIT
records.tagline: AI-Driven Trading Intelligence and Risk Insights
records.description: WAIT Inc. is an AI-driven trading intelligence platform built for serious traders, prop-firm candidates, and performance-focused institutions. We do not operate as a broker or advisor. We provide technology: real-time market signals, regime detection, and automated risk enforcement that helps users trade with discipline and consistency.

records.name: AdInflow
records.tagline: Set up Google Ads end-to-end — without doing it manually
records.description: Google Ads, done for you — without agencies or freelancers. Business inputs in, launch-ready ads out.

records.name: proap
records.tagline: Create quick, high quality project plans, ready for sharing
records.description: proap is purpose-built to support the creation and presentation of visual project plans/Plans on a Page (POAPs). Draw directly on screen, create from AI prompts, or upload existing data; proap’s automated design will help create a presentation in minutes. proap's output is high quality, clear, and accurate. Present on screen or take an instant Snapshot to capture your plan for sharing.

records.name: Aether CSS
records.tagline: Free Liquid Glass, Glassmorphism & Neumorphism CSS Generator
records.description: Create stunning liquid glass, glassmorphism and neumorphism CSS effects with our free online generator. Live preview, instant code export, and beautiful presets.

records.name: IlmTab
records.tagline: A spiritual sanctuary in every new tab
records.description: IlmTab transforms your new tab into a spiritual sanctuary with authentic Islamic content. Daily Quran verses with translations + audio, authentic Hadith from Sahih Bukhari & Muslim, Duas from Hisnul Muslim, prayer times with customization, 99 Names of Allah, morning/evening Adhkar, advanced Quran search, Tafsir commentary, favorites with notes, to-do list, and beautiful Islamic backgrounds. 100% free, privacy-first (all data stays in your browser), and available for Chrome, Firefox + Edge.

records.name: Excuse as a Service (ExaaS)
records.tagline: A tiny API that generates realistic excuses .
records.description: A tiny API that generates realistic excuses — random, category-based, and cowsay mode.

records.name: FinalRun
records.tagline: Your AI QA Agent for Mobile app
records.description: Finalrun lets you create end-to-end mobile app tests by simply describing the flow you want to validate in plain English. Run the same tests seamlessly on both Android and iOS without writing or maintaining manual scripts. Finalrun integrates directly into your CI/CD pipeline and reports failures via Email/Slack with clear, actionable insights, helping teams catch bugs early so they can focus on building what truly matters.

records.name: Rippletide Eval CLI
records.tagline: Rippletide CLI is an evaluation tool for AI agents
records.description: Rippletide CLI is an interactive terminal tool to evaluate AI agent endpoints directly from your command line. It generates questions from the agent’s knowledge, supports predefined questions for reproducible benchmarking, and delivers clear hallucination KPIs. Get instant feedback on performance with real time progress, automatic evaluation, and detailed reports.

records.name: Figy.ai
records.tagline: AI Flashcards That Grow as You Learn
records.description: Figy is a free AI that turns any topic or content into smart flashcards that actually stick. Upload notes, articles, or documents and get beautifully crafted AI flashcards in seconds. Learn faster, retain more, and stay in flow as Figy keeps updating and improving your cards while you learn. Perfect for students, educators, and lifelong learners who want learning to be engaging and memorable.

records.name: Trace
records.tagline: F**k The Algorithm. Make Your Own
records.description: Trace helps you keep up by pulling content from multiple sources — like YouTube, Reddit, Hacker News, Medium, and X — into one place. It learns from your work and feedback, remembers what matters, and surfaces signals from across the web without pulling you in.

records.name: Sapiare New Tab
records.tagline: Find inspiration every time you open a new tab.
records.description: Do you build products and companies? This minimal new-tab page showcases evocative visual thinking, a curated collection of paintings, and tweet-style quotes from history’s brightest minds.

records.name: Interactpitch
records.tagline: Interactive pitch decks with real-time viewer insights
records.description: InteractPitch turns your pitch deck into an interactive experience. After you share the deck ahead of a call, investors go through it with your AI avatar stepping in to explain and add context when needed. Interactpitch gives founders real time insights into who viewed the pitch, how deeply they engaged, which sections mattered, and what questions came up, so your first investor call starts confident and well prepared.

records.name: GitHub Game of Life
records.tagline: Visualizes GitHub contribution graphs as Game of Life
records.description: Visualize your GitHub contribution graph as Conway's Game of Life. Use the web app for a quick generation or GitHub Actions for automated daily updates. 🧫🧫🧫

records.name: NutriScan AI
records.tagline: Scan Food Menus & Labels for Instant Nutrition Insights
records.description: NutriScan AI uses AI vision and language models to turn food menus and nutrition labels into meaningful insights in seconds. Instantly see: Estimated calories Estimated macronutrients Health grade (A–F) Simple warnings like “High Oil” or “High Sugar” Free daily scans with optional Pro upgrade for deeper insights and unlimited scans.

records.name: HitUrl
records.tagline: Get Your Smart Link
records.description: Manage your short url, QR codes and bio links in one place

records.name: The Identity Blueprint
records.tagline: 91 Day Protocols. Systems for tracking who you are becoming.
records.description: Join The Identity Blueprint - A neuroscience-backed 91-day program to rewire your brain and transform your identity. Integrated with a "Live Interactive Brain" that gives you neurological feedback for every task you complete. 24/7 AI Mentor. It is not a tool for tracking what you do; it is a system for tracking who you are becoming. It is everything you need to transform your identity without paying thousands of dollars through high-ticket coaching or years of therapy, all in your pocket 24/7.

records.name: MediChat AI Health Assistant (Beta)
records.tagline: Open source AI health assistant trained on patient summaries
records.description: 🩺 Small Enough to Trust, Smart Enough to Help 🩺 While others build walled gardens around your most intimate health data, we offer an open source AI health assistant you can actually verify, own, and trust. Medichat provides: 💡 Symptom assessment, general medical knowledge, health guidance 💡 ICD-10, FHIR and medical codes 💡 Option to run locally We do not: 🚩 Use your health data to train AI models 🚩 Sell your information to third parties 🚩 Hide our methods behind proprietary walls

records.name: Easy Salon Software
records.tagline: Smart Technology for Modern Beauty Businesses
records.description: Easy Salon Software is an all-in-one online management platform designed for salons, spas, beauty studios, nail bars, and wellness centers. It streamlines appointments, staff scheduling, billing, inventory, and client management through a single intuitive dashboard. With features like digital invoicing, WhatsApp reminders, loyalty programs, memberships, and AI-powered multi-location management, it helps beauty businesses operate efficiently, boost customer satisfaction, and grow confidently.

records.name: Solve 24 - Math Puzzles
records.tagline: Can you solve 'em all!
records.description: Solve 24 is a fast, brain-teasing math puzzle game that challenges you to reach the number 24 using four given numbers and basic arithmetic. Easy to learn but tough to master, each round pushes you to think creatively and adapt quickly. Play at your own pace, race the clock in Time Trial mode, or challenge a friend in Face-Off. With endless puzzles and a colorful, intuitive design, Solve 24 is a fun mental workout for all ages.

records.name: Mocklingo- Ai interview tool
records.tagline: Practice real interviews with AI before the real one
records.description: Mocklingo helps freshers prepare for real job interviews using AI-powered mock interviews. Instead of memorizing answers, users practice speaking, thinking, and responding in realistic interview scenarios. Mocklingo simulates real interview pressure, gives instant feedback, and highlights areas like clarity, confidence, and structure. Built for students and early-career professionals, it makes interview preparation practical, affordable, and effective so candidates enter interviews confident.

records.name: daily.dev Recruiter
records.tagline: Hire from the world's largest developer community
records.description: Access passive talent who only respond on daily.dev. Post your role, get matched, and meet engineers who actually want to talk. Developers already use daily.dev every day to learn and grow. We’re now opening our network for hiring.

records.name: HiChicken
records.tagline: Peer recognition for Slack. Free for Small Teams
records.description: HiChicken is a recognition app for Slack. React to any message with a chicken emoji, and collect chickens to spend on rewards set by your team. I originally built this because I did not understand how simple slack apps (like recognition bots) were priced as per/seat add ons. What makes it different: • Small teams are free. No per-seat pricing for Larger teams. (and currently free) • Custom emoji recognition • Easy custom rewards We're in public beta and it's free for everyone right now

records.name: MCPJam Inspector
records.tagline: Test + develop ChatGPT apps and MCP apps (ext-apps) locally
records.description: MCPJam inspector is the local testing tool for ChatGPT apps and MCP servers. Build your apps locally with MCPJam's widget emulator and test against any LLM in the playground. Inspect your MCP server’s tools, resources, prompts, and OAuth flows. No more ngrok or ChatGPT subscription needed.

records.name: RenderArchi
records.tagline: Minimalist AI renderer for architects & designers.
records.description: A professional AI renderer designed for architects and interior designers. Why choose RenderArchi: 1. Faithful: Respects your exact geometry and lines. No hallucinations. 2. Simple: Zero learning curve. No complex prompting. Supports reference images. 3. Fast: Transform sketches to realistic renders in seconds. 4. High Quality: Production-ready high-res images for presentations.

records.name: 物件スカウター（賃貸版）
records.tagline: SUUMOの賃貸物件を賢く比較。㎡単価・初期費用・AI判定を自動表示
records.description: 日本の賃貸物件探しを効率化するChrome拡張機能です。 SUUMOで物件を見るとき、こんな悩みはありませんか？ ・㎡単価が分からず、コスパ比較が難しい ・敷金・礼金・仲介手数料...初期費用の合計が分からない ・この家賃、本当に適正なの？ 物件スカウターがすべて解決します。 【主な機能】 📊 ㎡単価を自動計算・表示 💰 初期費用（敷金・礼金・仲介手数料等）を一括計算 📅 年間コスト・2年間総コストを表示 ⭐ お気に入り保存＆比較表 📁 CSV/Excelエクスポート 🤖 AI賃料判定（お得/適正/割高） 【特徴】 ✅ 完全無料 ✅ 広告なし ✅ データ外部送信なし（プライバシー重視） ✅ オフラインでも動作 日本で賃貸物件を探している方、ぜひお試しください！

records.name: GribStream - Weather forecasts database.
records.tagline: State of the art models like NOAA's NBM and ECMWF's IFS
records.description: Stop fighting weather data. GribStream gives you clean time-series forecasts from major public models—instantly. Pull any variable and coordinates, including full forecast history (every run exactly as it was published) so you can backtest, and train models without leakage—cheap in bulk and built for high throughput. Most weather APIs give you “latest.” GribStream gives you every forecast that ever existed. Query public models as clean time series, pick any “as-of” run for backtesting.

records.name: relayd
records.tagline: Remote control for your Codex agents. Ship from anywhere.
records.description: Most tools let you monitor agents. relayd lets you control them — from your phone. A lightweight daemon connects your local Codex to a mobile PWA. Get push notifications when agents finish, see full context, and push to continue with one tap. Your code never leaves your machine. Unlike generic monitoring tools, relayd is built specifically for agentic coding workflows. It's not just alerts — it's a remote control. Built by an indie dev, for indie devs. Your desk is now optional.

records.name: Folio
records.tagline: Look hireable within minutes
records.description: Most website builders waste your time. Folio doesn’t. Create and host a clean, professional one page site for yourself in minutes, not days. No tweaking, no AI experiments, no bloated builders. Just a clean page with a fixed layout, SEO optimized and designed to convert. Show your work, services, and testimonials then capture leads with a built in form.

records.name: PressMeGPT.com
records.tagline: WordPress AI Website Builder & Theme Generator
records.description: The Easiest AI Wordpress Theme Generator: Build beautiful WordPress websites with no code. Describe your vision, choose from AI-generated designs, edit with prompts, and export a complete Gutenberg-ready theme. No Wordpress page builders or plugins required that might create security holes or slow down your website. Try it out with 15 free credits (enough for 2-3 themes) and get 50% off for life for being a Product Hunter PLUS credits that never expire with the coupon code: 50HUNT
